messages.text: BL-1657 🎵 in progress — check_art_director_tip.sh judges every art-director tip against the literal branch primary/art-director, which exists on the nested pack and never on this host, so the guard has refused every live tip since it shipped on 2026-09-06 and QA verifies each art-director land by hand (2026-09-20, b4cce6448c): the guard resolves the branch from the roster row for the art-director seat, refuses naming the ref and its source when it cannot, and accepts an explicit --branch
